columns.description:
Should follow the
@tanstack /react-table [ColumnDef](https://tanstack.com/table/v8/docs/guide/column-defs).
[createColumnHelper](https://tanstack.com/table/v8/docs/guide/column-defs#column-helpers) is also exposed to make it more convenient
to create columns.

data.description:
The actual data that will be used for the table.
Typescript should infer T from typeof data.

emptyState.description: The elements to display when the data table is empty

height.description: This will force the table to have the specified hight

loading.description: When true, shows the loading state of the DataTable

onRowClick.description: Enables row click action. The provided callback will be executed when the row is clicked.

pinFirstColumn.description: Pins the firstColumn when scrolling horizontally

stickyHeader.description: When set to true makes the header sticky while scrolling vertically

ariaLabel.description:
Function that returns the aria-label for the button. Required for accessibility.
Should return translated strings based on the direction parameter.

direction.description: The direction of the pagination button

disabled.description: Whether the pagination button is disabled

onClick.description: Callback function when the pagination button is clicked

align.description: The horizontal alignment of the header content and sort icon.

children.description: The header content to display (text, icons, etc.)

direction.description: The current sort direction for this column. When undefined, the header renders as non-interactive.

onSort.description:
Callback function triggered when the sortable header is clicked.
When undefined, the header renders as non-interactive.

layout.description:
Controls the table layout.
- `auto` (default): Columns size to content.
- `fixed`: Column widths can be set explicitly; columns without widths share remaining space.
